title: Average days kept per genre
statementMd:
Average number of days a book is kept per genre (returned loans only), rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `genre`, `avg_days`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.genre, ROUND(AVG(julianday(l.return_date) - julianday(l.loan_date)), 1) AS avg_days FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id WHERE l.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.genre;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
